task: F001 Countdown Prelaunch Screen — countdown UI + site-wide navigation-lock gate
acceptanceCriteria: countdown-screen.tsx ticks every second, clamps at 0, clears interval on unmount
Title reads VI/EN from NEXT_LOCALE cookie
app/page.tsx wires the env var through
middleware created with the matcher excluding static assets
Redirect fires for any non-/ path before target time
No redirect fires for any path at/after target time (including / itself)
Malformed/missing env var fails open (no redirect) rather than crashing
blastRadius: proxy.ts gates every route in the app (site-wide, every visitor); countdown UI changes are scoped to the / route only.
contracts: None external — proxy.ts/middleware is Next.js's own file convention, not a project-defined API contract.
